title: Public NHEFS teaching subset
collector: US CDC National Center for Health Statistics
subsetSource: Miguel Hernan and James Robins, Causal Inference: What If
reuseBasis: NCHS states its material is public domain unless otherwise stated; the author identifies this file as a subset of these public-use data. Attribute collector and subset source. No textbook PDF or figure is redistributed.
transformation: CSV retained byte-for-byte. Example selects qsmk, wt82_71 and nine baseline covariates, fits only finite outcomes, and standardizes over all rows. No linkage or enrichment.
targetQualification: Selected available teaching cohort, not full original NHEFS or nationally representative target. Working iid record bootstrap is not survey-design inference.
